description.value: Pasta Polo is an Italian restaurant in Langley's Willowbrook area specializing in freshly made pasta dishes with quality ingredients. The menu leans heavily on vegetable-forward pasta options and includes gluten-friendly choices alongside classics like eggplant parmesan and pesto linguine. Touring cyclists can order online for pickup, dine in, or arrange delivery.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms an active Italian pasta restaurant in Langley. Phone 604-532-5661 and website URL are corroborated by the website; however, OSM lists unit 114 while the website's /location page explicitly states unit 116 at 19665 Willowbrook Drive — flagged as a discrepancy. The menu page lists multiple vegetarian pasta dishes and several items marked 'NON GF' implying others are gluten-friendly, supporting a vegetarian/GF amenity value; takeout is explicitly confirmed throughout the site. No evidence exists on the website for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging.
